ruling.recommended_action: Pay the rider a $3.74 voucher (Ryde reference: refund of metered distance on the two unexempted off-route segments) and record on the driver's file a single upheld RD-1 route-deviation finding; no account flag.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 22:57–23:03 adding 1.14 km [F3]. No traffic incident qualifies and band-3 speed alone does not exempt [F14][F12][RD-4]. The complete, timestamped chat holds no rider message naming or agreeing to any route before 22:57 — only a pickup note and an arrival note [F8][F9][F10][RD-5], and the driver's post-trip statement of GPS rerouting is a claim, not rider consent [F11][RD-5]. No rider-named stop in this segment [RD-3]. Refundable under RD-2.

Off-route segment 23:21–23:24 adding 1.51 km [F4]. No qualifying incident [F14][RD-4], no rider message of any kind before 23:21 in the complete timestamped record [F8][F9][F10][RD-5], and no rider-named stop [RD-3]. The driver's statement cannot supply consent [F11][RD-5]. Refundable under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Its own premise supports the refund: the fare is a metered RydeTAXI total with distance billed at $35.17 ÷ 24.9 km = $1.41/km [F7], and once the two segments are unexempted [F3][F4][RD-4][RD-5] RD-2 requires refunding 2.65 km × $1.41 = $3.74; the claim is rejected only in so far as it seeks to leave that distance with the driver.

Withdrawn by the driver's own rebuttal and unsupported: no incident is recorded on the replaced stretch [F14] and band-3 readings are at most corroboration and never exempt a segment [F12][F13][RD-4].
Accepted only as to time: no time or waiting element is refundable [F7][RD-3(c)], but it does not diminish the distance refund, since the segments are measured distance [F3][F4][RD-2].

The amount is accepted, but the driver's framing that the two segments 'match' the +3.1 km overrun [F1] is rejected: 2.65 km of measured segments plus an unbilled residual does not make the trip-level figure refundable; RD-2 refunds segment extra_km only [F3][F4][F5][F7].

The rider's arithmetic reaches the same $3.74 and is granted, but its reliance on the trip-level +3.1 km / $4.41 overrun as the refund base is rejected: RD-2 limits the refund to the extra_km of unexempted segments [F1][F3][F4][F5][RD-2].

The +14% distance and +21.8 min overrun are accepted as context confirming the deviations are real [F1][F2], but they are not themselves the refundable quantity; the refund base is the measured segment kilometres [F3][F4][RD-2].
